description: An oil-style painting of a colossal bronze-coloured statue of a bald man in a long coat and loose trousers, standing on a rocky island in a dark river. Beneath his feet is a large red-brick, stepped building with tiny figures on its roofs and terraces, and a concrete structure runs off to the right. Dark, stormy mountains and clouds fill the background. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing gory.
